explanation: Holy chest that contained Israel's holy relics, including the two stone tablets with the Ten Commandments.
King David was the second king of Israel and a central figure in the Old Testament. In 1 Chronicles 13 he wants to bring the ark to Jerusalem.
A man from David's time who died when he touched the ark during transport, which was forbidden.
The holy city and capital of ancient Israel, the place where David wanted to place the ark.
A people who lived in Canaan and were enemies of Israel. They had previously taken the ark, but returned it after experiencing plagues.
A man who took care of the ark in his house after the Philistines returned it to Israel.
Abinadab's son, appointed by David to look after the ark in his father's house.
